payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Change the black DVD to white while retaining its identity as a DVD.
outcome.target: The DVD is visibly white rather than black.
outcome.reference: The black DVD in the input image.

check.question: Is the black DVD from the source image visibly transformed into a white DVD in the edited image?
check.complete_when: The source DVD is visibly white in the edited image, with no separate black DVD remaining as the original object.
check.partial_when: The source DVD shows some visible progress toward becoming white, but remains partly black or its transformation is incomplete.
check.absent_when: The source DVD remains black or is no longer present as a transformed white DVD; a separate white disc elsewhere does not count as progress.
check.unknown_when: The source DVD cannot be reliably identified or its color and transformation cannot be assessed from the images.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The source DVD at the center has been replaced by a white disc, but the edited image also shows a separate black-and-white disc near the dark object, so the source DVD’s transformation is not clearly complete."}
